proofBoundary: build/report parity matrix only; parse-only/build-only/preflight-only/probe-only entries are not runtime proof; not real-model-runtime proof; not full trtexec replacement proof; not package-consumer-runtime proof
ownerEvidenceRequiredForPromotion: real TensorRtExec or OnnxToEngine build report hash
YoloVision or Classification Passed=True in a real run log
clean external package-consumer-runtime proof for release package claims

entries.proofBoundary: ONNX path selection is build input only; it is not runtime proof.
entries.notes: External ONNX path or embedded identity model when omitted.

entries.proofBoundary: Serialized engine output is build artifact evidence only.
entries.notes: Serialized engine output or dry-run report path.

entries.proofBoundary: Engine readback metadata and SHA256 are dependency/preflight evidence; bounded one-float-input enqueue/readback can run but cannot promote real-model or package-consumer proof without expected output evidence.
entries.notes: Records engine metadata/SHA256 and may execute bounded runtime output for compatible float engines.

entries.proofBoundary: Profile shape application is build evidence until a real sample run validates the binding.
entries.notes: Dynamic profile shape triplets.

entries.proofBoundary: Shape alias normalization does not prove runtime output correctness.
entries.notes: Seeds profile triplet when explicit min/opt/max are absent.

entries.proofBoundary: FP16 builder flag is not proof of model accuracy or runtime package consumption.
entries.notes: Applied when runtime reaches builder config.

entries.proofBoundary: Conditional precision availability is not promoted without compatible host runtime logs.
entries.notes: Parsed and reported; availability depends on TensorRT line.

entries.proofBoundary: Parse/report-only precision intent cannot be claimed as implemented TensorRT behavior.
entries.notes: Parsed, normalized, and reported as precision intent; capability and model proof are not promoted.

entries.proofBoundary: INT8/calibrator ownership remains blocked until safe calibrator lifecycle and real calibration proof exist.
entries.notes: Parsed/report-only until safe calibration ownership is implemented.

entries.proofBoundary: Workspace limit application is not runtime output proof.
entries.notes: Active builder workspace limit with unit parsing.

entries.proofBoundary: Memory pool set/get readback proves builder-config acceptance only; it is not runtime output, model accuracy, or package-consumer proof.
entries.notes: Known trtexec pool tokens are mapped to TensorRtMemoryPoolType, applied during a real build, and read back through TensorRtBuilderConfig.GetMemoryPoolLimit. Dry-run and load-engine remain parse-only.

entries.proofBoundary: Tensor type/allowed-format readback proves parsed-network policy application only; it does not prove caller binding layout, model accuracy, or package-consumer runtime.
entries.notes: One specification broadcasts or the specification count must match network I/O count. TRT8/10 set type and formats; TRT11 sets formats only when the requested type already equals the inferred type.

entries.proofBoundary: Constraint flag and layer setter readback is builder evidence only; it does not prove tactic choice, numerical accuracy, real-model runtime, or package consumption.
entries.notes: TRT8/10 apply prefer/obey flags and resolved layer rules. Exact names beat wildcard rules, later duplicates win, and one output type broadcasts. TRT11 removed these setters and remains parse-only.

entries.proofBoundary: Tactic source set/get readback proves builder-config acceptance only; it does not prove which tactic was selected or model performance.
entries.notes: Normalized +/- tokens are applied relative to TensorRT defaults and read back during real builds.

entries.proofBoundary: Timing cache import and its SHA256 are build-cache evidence only; they are not model accuracy, runtime execution, or package-consumer proof.
entries.notes: The typed TensorRtTimingCache owner imports the caller-provided file during build and records size/SHA256.

entries.proofBoundary: Timing cache export and its SHA256 are build-cache evidence only; they are not model accuracy, runtime execution, or package-consumer proof.
entries.notes: The typed TensorRtTimingCache owner serializes the cache after a successful build and records output size/SHA256.

entries.proofBoundary: Plugin path normalization does not load/register/deregister plugin libraries and is not plugin runtime proof.
entries.notes: Repeated plugin aliases are normalized into the plugin path list; no plugin library is loaded, registered, deregistered, or serialized by this stage.

entries.proofBoundary: Profile verbosity reports are not enqueue/profile runtime proof for external models.
entries.notes: Normalized to none, layer_names_only, or detailed.

entries.proofBoundary: Dry run and preview never parse/build/execute; they cannot promote proof.
entries.notes: No runtime probing, ONNX parsing, engine build, or inference.

entries.proofBoundary: SparseWeights flag readback does not prove that a sparse tactic was selected. Force remains parse-only because official force mode rewrites weights.
entries.notes: enable/disable set and read back SparseWeights; force is explicitly not applied.

entries.proofBoundary: Builder flag/network creation proves policy application only, not model accuracy, DLA execution, or package consumption.
entries.notes: DirectIO is set/read back; stronglyTyped uses the TRT10 raw bit, relies on the TRT11 always-strongly-typed contract, and remains parse-only on TRT8.

entries.proofBoundary: Builder-flag and ICudaEngine refittable readback prove refit capability only; they do not provide replacement weights or model accuracy proof.
entries.notes: TRT8/10/11 use the typed Refit flag. TRT8 keeps refit parse-only when combined with versionCompatible because vendor readback rejects that combination.

entries.proofBoundary: TRT10 source-tree evidence covers in-memory refit and baseline output comparison only; the saved plan remains stripped and no package-consumer proof is promoted.
entries.notes: Requires --onnx --stripWeights --refit; captures copied inventory/diagnostics, commits with RefitCudaEngine, and permits context creation only after the complete gate.

entries.proofBoundary: TRT10 source-tree evidence proves ExcludeWeights clear/readback, persisted full-weight bytes, original-owner disposal, independent reload and baseline comparison. Separate local-feed PackageReference evidence reproduces the output hash, but public-feed and post-publish proof remain external.
entries.notes: Requires --refitFromOnnx; output must differ from the stripped plan and ONNX source, and optional runtime uses the reloaded engine. A full-weight TRT10 reload need not remain refittable.

entries.proofBoundary: Refit inventory and debug tensor output require model-specific copied metadata and runtime artifacts.
entries.notes: Debug/refit-dump intent remains in ParseOnlyOptions; no runtime output proof is promoted.

entries.proofBoundary: Builder flag readback and serialized plan creation are packaging evidence only; they do not prove cross-version deployment, external lean-runtime loading, or refit completion.
entries.notes: VersionCompatible and ExcludeLeanRuntime apply on TRT8/10/11. StripWeights applies StripPlan plus RefitIdentical by default on TRT10/11 and remains explicit TRT8 parse-only.

entries.proofBoundary: Builder flag, streamable-weight size, budget, and scratch readback prove local weight-streaming policy application; they do not prove performance, accuracy, package consumption, or public release.
entries.notes: Supports -2, -1, 0..100%, and byte-size grammar. TRT10/11 set the budget before execution-context creation; TRT8 remains parse-only.

entries.proofBoundary: Device selection and DLA/GPU fallback readback prove host configuration only; DLA model execution still requires a DLA-capable host and real model evidence.
entries.notes: Device work runs on a dedicated host thread; DLA core is range-checked against builder capability and builder config values are read back.

entries.proofBoundary: Independent execution contexts, CUDA streams, host driver threads, event polling, graph capture/launch, stream-ordered start delay, transfer suppression, warmup, minimum iteration/duration scheduling, idle gaps, timing-average windows, and percentile statistics prove bounded scheduler execution only. noDataTransfers suppresses output readback and cannot prove correctness; none of these mechanics proves package consumption.
entries.notes: Compatible float engines report requested/applied values, per-context rounds, threads, graph fallback reason, raw GPU timing samples, and averaged timing windows. Sleep time uses bridge-owned native callback state plus one event fan-out; CUDA graph is applied only when every context captures and instantiates successfully.

entries.proofBoundary: A dedicated bridge entry point owns cudaLaunchHostFunc state and fans one completion event out to all inference streams before warmup; this is scheduler behavior evidence, not model correctness or package-consumer proof.
entries.notes: Caller-thread sleep and managed callbacks are not used for --sleepTime.

entries.proofBoundary: Named float input files feed every engine input in binding order, but loading inputs alone is not expected-output validation or package-consumer-runtime proof.
entries.notes: Mappings must cover every input when supplied; missing, duplicate, and unknown names fail closed. Without --loadInputs, deterministic input is generated independently for each tensor.

entries.proofBoundary: Every captured float output gets a bounded preview, shape, byte count, and SHA256; capture is not expected-value validation or model proof.
entries.notes: Build-only/no-transfer paths remain non-applied; successful readback emits one bounded line per output tensor.

entries.proofBoundary: Raw bytes and their offset/hash manifest prove output capture only. Unmatched output keeps HasRawBindingProof=false and cannot promote runtime correctness.
entries.notes: All float outputs are concatenated in engine order; the adjacent manifest records tensor names, shapes, byte ranges, and individual/combined hashes.

entries.proofBoundary: OutputTensors preserves every captured float output as bounded metadata; output, timing, and profile exports still require expected values and owner evidence for promotion.
entries.notes: Build-only writes non-proof boundaries; successful readback writes ordered tensor metadata without fabricating reference validation.

entries.proofBoundary: All outputs must match schemaVersion=1 traceable references under explicit finite tolerances and special-value policies. Synthetic reference validation is not real-model or package-consumer proof.
entries.notes: Artifacts record reference paths and SHA256, source classification, actual/reference shapes and counts, mismatch count, first mismatch, maximum errors, and deterministic diagnostics.
